Typing CDSYNC prints '[CE] CDSYNC will re-link every pit and pipe in this drawing' and later 'CDSYNC complete. not_automated: D27 CDREBUILD is not driven (its prompts are unknown). The U echo and the equal object count do not prove that the relinked records were restored.
The schedule HEADER (issue header, counters) is not compared: only the grid rows and cells. A look at the schedule layout is a separate Codex look (R25).
